children.text: This 2015 Martí Noticias report documents the

, held in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on August 13–15, 2015. Convened by Cubanos Unidos de Puerto Rico, the gathering brought together organizations of the Cuban internal opposition and exile community to explore common political strategies and channels of coordination. The event took place shortly after the restoration of diplomatic relations between Cuba and the United States under the Obama administration, creating a historically significant context for discussions of the U.S. embargo, political disagreement, and collective action.

Reported from San Juan by Gricel González, the video includes interventions by opposition figures and illustrates how Puerto Rico served as a meeting place for transnational Cuban political networks. Produced by Martí Noticias, a U.S.-based broadcaster rather than a Puerto Rican news organization, the report is examined both as a record of political organizing and as a mediated representation of Cuban exile activity.
The accompanying annotations focus on diasporic political coordination, disagreements surrounding the embargo, and appeals to shared Cuban responsibility across territorial boundaries.
